options.content:
One short sample. Reported data and indicative prices. Not executable and not profit.

Candidates: lowest turnover among pairs at or above median reported liquidity. Unknown fees stay for review. Depth estimates ignore tick crossings. Mint flags are OnChain; liquidity and prices are Reported.

targets.rawSql: SELECT run_id,data->>'started_epoch' AS "Start epoch",data->>'finished_epoch' AS "End epoch",data->>'public_requests' AS "Public requests",data->>'rpc_calls' AS "Tatum calls",data->'partial_sources' AS "Partial sources",data->'limits_reached' AS "Limits reached",evidence_kind FROM research.pool_map_runs

WITH steps AS (SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('R1',1),('R2',2),('R3',3),('R4',4),('R5',5)) s(step,n)) SELECT step, count(*) FILTER (WHERE data->>'failed_step' IS NULL OR substring(data->>'failed_step',2)::int>=n) AS "Entering",count(*) FILTER (WHERE data->>'failed_step' IS NULL OR substring(data->>'failed_step',2)::int>n) AS "Leaving or retained for review",count(*) FILTER (WHERE step='R5' AND data->>'failed_step' IS NULL AND data->>'reason'='Not measured') AS "Fee comparison not measured",(SELECT jsonb_object_agg(reason,total) FROM (SELECT data->>'reason' AS reason,count(*) AS total FROM research.pair_requirements WHERE data->>'failed_step'=step GROUP BY data->>'reason') rejected) AS "Rejection reasons",'Reported' AS "Evidence" FROM research.pair_requirements CROSS JOIN steps GROUP BY step,n ORDER BY n

panels.title: Reported candidates — lowest turnover above median liquidity

targets.rawSql: SELECT pair_id AS "Pair",data->>'turnover' AS "Turnover",data->>'price_disagreement_bps' AS "Price disagreement bps",data->>'sample_movement_bps' AS "Sample movement bps",data->>'liquidity_imbalance' AS "Liquidity imbalance",data->>'combined_fee_bps' AS "Combined fee bps",data->>'near_price_depth_usd_estimate' AS "OnChain depth estimate USD",data->>'failed_step' AS "First failed step",data->>'reason' AS "Reason",data->'freeze_flags' AS "OnChain mint flags",evidence_kind AS "Evidence" FROM research.pair_clues WHERE data->>'list'='Candidates' ORDER BY (data->>'turnover')::numeric,pair_id

SELECT pair_id AS "Pair",data->>'turnover' AS "Turnover",data->>'price_disagreement_bps' AS "Price disagreement bps",data->>'sample_movement_bps' AS "Sample movement bps",data->>'liquidity_imbalance' AS "Liquidity imbalance",data->>'combined_fee_bps' AS "Combined fee bps",data->>'near_price_depth_usd_estimate' AS "OnChain depth estimate USD",data->>'failed_step' AS "First failed step",data->>'reason' AS "Reason",data->'freeze_flags' AS "OnChain mint flags",evidence_kind AS "Evidence" FROM research.pair_requirements WHERE data->>'control'='true' ORDER BY pair_id

SELECT pool_id,data->>'venue' AS "Venue",data->>'mint0' AS "Mint 0",data->>'mint1' AS "Mint 1",data->>'created' AS "Created epoch",data->>'liquidity' AS "Reported liquidity USD",evidence_kind FROM research.pool_map_pools WHERE data->>'new_pool'='true' ORDER BY pool_id
